blocks.text: You can configure the Zscaler service to email specific individuals when certain events occur, so your organization can take action in a timely manner. You can create an alert for different types of events, such as when the service detects incoming or outgoing malware or when there is a policy violation. To learn more, see About Alerts.
The Alert Subscriptions page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: Receive immediate email notifications when critical security events such as malware detection or policy violations occur.
Customize notifications for specific event types, giving the organization or department a focused visibility into the security incidents.

blocks.text: On the Publish Alerts page (Administration > Alerts > Internet & SaaS > Publish Alerts), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Modify the table and its columns.
View a list of all alert subscriptions. For alert subscriptions, you can see the following:
Email: The email address of the alert recipient.
Description: The description of the alert subscription, if available.
Patient 0 Alerts: Lists the severity levels of the Patient 0 Alert class information that the recipient receives.
Security Alerts: Lists the severity levels of the Secure Alert class information that the recipient receives.
Access Control Alerts: Lists the severity levels of the Access Control Alert class information that the recipient receives.
Data Loss Prevention Alerts: Lists the severity levels of the Data Loss Prevention Alert class information that the recipient receives.
System Alerts: Lists the severity levels of the System Alert class information that the recipient receives.
The alert subscriptions are paginated with up to 500 alerts per page.
Go to the Define Alerts page.
Go to the Global Configuration page.
